ModMetaData.name: 工坊损耗 Workshop Wear
ModMetaData.author: WorkshopWear
ModMetaData.description:
Workstations wear slowly. Overwork for a day of speed at double wear — and a chance to jam. Two repair tiers: slapdash (cheap steel) or proper (components, clears jam).
Default scope: stoves, smithies, machining, tailoring, drug lab, fabrication-like benches. Research and sculpting are opt-in. Easy mode: half wear, no jam.
Playability first: player decisions (overwork vs maintain), settings, EN+CN.
